A.note: Bright saturated sea, readable ship line with smoke puffs and a clear fort. The ground is flat, smooth and sandy, and the buildings are clean blocks like game pieces. The smoke clouds look like sprites.

B.note: Moodier, hazier atmosphere, grassy ground with some texture, and a more natural sea. The large orange explosion glow is blobby and hides the middle of the frame. The distant ships fade into the haze and are hard to read.

C.note: Nearly the same as A with a flatter sea and slightly less smoke. The buildings are still cubic and toy-like, and the terrain is smooth. The small explosion keeps the frame readable but unremarkable.

why: B has the most atmospheric depth, the least toy-like feel and the best ground texture, despite its overblown explosion glow. A and C are bright but flat, with block-like buildings.
top_fix_for_best: Shrink and soften the central explosion glow so it doesn't hide the town. Add real ship silhouettes with visible gun-flash and smoke trails. Give the buildings roof and wall texture and variation, and add small figures or defenders on the walls to set scale.
